movie.title: Keep Real
movie.overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Decades after defeating an alien invasion, a legendary hero struggles to assemble a new combat team in a peaceful town where local customs and social dynamics prove harder to navigate than extraterrestrial threats.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Thirty years after leading the Super Ying Association to a decisive victory over invading aliens, Superman Wang Changhai receives a new assignment. He is sent back to his hometown in Rheinland to form an elite combat squad. However, the town has enjoyed decades of peace, making the locals immune to urgency and heavily reliant on traditional social courtesies. Wang quickly realizes that maneuvering through human relationships, bureaucracy, and small-town politics presents a far greater obstacle to his mission than any alien invasion ever did.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Thirty years ago, Earth faced an existential alien threat that was ultimately squashed by the Super Ying Association, led by the renowned hero Wang Changhai. Following decades of peace, central authorities decide it is time to establish a new specialized combat squad to ensure long-term security, appointing Wang to lead the initiative. He is dispatched to his quiet hometown of Rheinland, a place that has long forgotten the horrors of war and embraced a slow, tranquil way of life. Expecting to easily recruit and train a disciplined unit, Wang is instead confronted with a web of deeply ingrained social expectations, local favors, and interpersonal drama. The townspeople prioritize harmony, personal ties, and traditional courtesies over military rigor, treating his urgent task as an unnecessary disturbance. Every attempt Wang makes to enforce order or initiate training is met with humorous misunderstandings, passive resistance, and bureaucratic delays. As tension mounts between his strict military duty and the relaxed rhythm of small-town culture, Wang finds himself completely overwhelmed. To succeed, he must learn to navigate the subtle rules of human relationships without losing sight of his original objective.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Keep Real follows former superhero leader Wang Changhai, who famously saved the world from an alien threat thirty years prior with the Super Ying Association. Assigned to establish a new combat squad in his peaceful hometown of Rheinland, Wang anticipates a straightforward tactical mission. Instead, he finds himself pitted against the subtle complexities of small-town social etiquette, local politics, and human sentiment. Blending comedy, sci-fi, and drama, the narrative explores the clash between a disciplined hero's sense of duty and the charming, yet frustratingly relaxed lifestyle of a community that has known peace for decades.
